Your to-do app thinks every day is the same.
But if you live with a chronic illness, it isn't.
Some days you have energy for everything. Some days, one lecture is the whole day.
This is Spoons. It plans your day by energy, not hours.
Every morning, check in. Today, Ada has eight spoons.
Spoons fills her battery with what fits, and keeps one spoon in reserve, so she never runs on empty.
Too big for today? It plans just the first part.
And everything that doesn't fit gets a next step. Not guilt.
A friend could grab her prescription. The message is already written.
Bad day? Drop to three spoons, and Spoons switches to Low Power mode. Must-dos only.
Can't make a deadline? A request for more time is ready to send.
When a lecture drains more than expected, she logs it, and the whole day re-plans. Instantly.
It even learns what her tasks really cost.
And it's built for everyone: keyboard, screen readers, read-aloud, high contrast, and a reading-friendly font.
No account. Works offline. Her data never leaves her device.
Spoons. Plan your day by energy, not hours.
